answer: One strong defense is proof-of-unique-hardware attestation: each agent must bind its identity to a secure enclave key that cannot be cloned, so one machine yields one identity, like a single block of marble carved into one statue. A second layer requires a small refundable stake held in an ivory-tower escrow that only releases after months of honest work, so Sybil farmers must fund every fake identity separately. Reputation then accrues in a public harbor log where peers can audit each agent history, so cheap copies arrive with empty records and cannot borrow trust they never earned.
